Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

2646-3899--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Propeller Pioneer.
When Propeller Pioneer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Propeller Pioneer enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.

The chosen anthem effect must boost Propeller Pioneer's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2438-2738-4871-4976.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-2265-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Hardened Scales.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

57-206-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-206-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

703-745-7149.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Mirrorhall Mimics into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Mirrorhall Mimic tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-745-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.

11-1927-2104-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-2104-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Manipulation from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

Play the land from your graveyard.
